service.description: Education help for the children of a registered construction worker (e-Nirman / BOCW).
service.depending: Aadhaar Card of the student, last marksheet, fee receipt or bonafide certificate, income certificate, caste certificate (if any), bank passbook, passport size photo, e-Nirman card of the parent
service.rules: Apply before the last date. The school / college must verify the form online. Keep the student's login ID and password in the job.
